parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description: The query condition for the baseline.

parameters.name: CriteriaType
parameters.description:
The query type of the baseline to query. Valid values:

- **BaselineNameAlias**: baseline name

- **BaselineClassAlias**: baseline category.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when using paging. Default value: 20, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: **20**, which indicates that 20 logon configuration entries are displayed per page.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level of the baseline to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). By default, all levels are included. Valid values:

- **high**: high risk

- **medium**: medium risk

- **low**: low risk.
